llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple scam characteristics: (1) Lacks legitimate business information (no address, phone, or verified company details); (2) Uses a well-known brand (Bikkembergs) without proof of official affiliation or authorization; (3) Generic and ambiguous privacy policy without legal details or data handling transparency; (4) SSL certificate issues suggesting poor security; (5) The domain's WHOIS lacks registrant transparency, which combined with all other points, signals a high likelihood of being a scam/fake online shopping site.
